links.outcome: LLM accuracy on anesthesiology attending exam questions, with clinical scenario and reasoning subgroups
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 70.6-73.4%, GPT-4 68.6-70.3%, DeepSeek-V3 53.1-55.5%, GPT-3.5 52.2-55.7%; all models struggled with clinical scenarios and advanced reasoning.
links.quote: All models excelled in basic knowledge and Type A1 questions but struggled with clinical scenarios and advanced reasoning.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) on the Chinese anesthesiology attending physician examination question bank (medical exam benchmark).
